blocking_finding.severity: blocker for the task's last acceptance line and for AC13/AC14 (t6/t8)
blocking_finding.statement: Every mpd plugin resolves the adapter through the AGENTS.md §6 idiom, so its src imports ../../mpd-dsh-adapter-plugin/src/index and bun BUNDLES the adapter's TypeScript source into that package's own dist/index.js. Editing packages/mpd-dsh-adapter-plugin/src/index.ts therefore makes 17 committed consumer dists stale. `node scripts/verify-dist-fresh.mjs` cannot be GREEN until those 17 are rebuilt, and they are outside this task's inScope (T-88: packages/*/dist/** belongs to the integration task's inScope; a lane must not declare a dist/** pattern for itself).
proof: A. gate: 17 STALE / 3 FRESH; the 3 FRESH are mpd-bundle-plugin (no adapter import), mpd-ext-plugin/dist/sdk.js (no adapter import) and mpd-dsh-adapter-plugin itself.
B. set identity: exactly the 18 entries whose FRESH build embeds adapter code (grep 'mpd-dsh-adapter:') = the 17 STALE targets + the adapter itself.

C. byte-causality: with HEAD's adapter src (sha256 8826eb6d2b7a4b34…), packages/mpd-roles-plugin and packages/mpd-tools-plugin rebuild BYTE-IDENTICALLY to their committed dists (98180ed1c3f7a4ca…, 248dbf383aea3fea…). Both were therefore fresh before this change and are stale only because of it.

D. the canonical rebuild command reproduces the gate's fresh build byte-for-byte: the scratch rebuild used a DIFFERENT --outfile path and still matched the committed bytes, so the 17 rebuilds below close the gate by construction.
